title: Include
summary: Loads a part of the page from an address: a skeleton while it loads, the server's HTML in its place when it arrives (the Loader starts the components in it), an error with Retry when it does not. load="view" waits until the part nears the viewport.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

src.description: The address of the part: a page of the site's own server that answers with HTML. Same origin by default; another origin only when its server allows it by CORS. Changing it loads the new part; empty, nothing is fetched and the placeholder stays

load.description: When the part is fetched: now, as soon as the element is on the page; view, once, when it comes within 200 px of the viewport (an IntersectionObserver; where there is none, at once)

lines.description: How many text lines the placeholder skeleton draws while the part loads, when the page gives no placeholder of its own

refresh.summary: Fetches src again now, whatever load says (vocabulary refresh: it re-reads). Answers applied when the part arrived, refused {reason: no-src | network | http} when there is no address or the load failed, cancelled when a newer load (a changed src, another refresh) replaced it or the element was removed. The Retry button of the error state calls it

sf-include-loaded.summary: The part arrived and is on the page: src is the address as given, status the HTTP status. Sent after the markup is inserted, so a listener finds it in the element

sf-include-load-failed.summary: The part did not arrive: reason network (the request failed, or another origin refused it by CORS; status null) or http (the server answered outside 200-299; status is its code). The element shows the error state with Retry

forbidden_client_responsibilities: deciding who may see the part (the server answers it, or refuses with a status)

keyboard: Tab reaches Retry in the error state
accessibility.focus: Focus on Retry moves to the region (tabindex -1) while the part loads again, so it never falls to the page; a new failure hands it to the new Retry.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-include to put a part of the page that the site's server answers at an address into the page: a news block, a list rendered on the server, a part below the fold loaded once it nears the viewport (load="view").
do_not: Do not use sf-include for data a component asks a host for; a host port does that
Do not rely on scripts in the answer: they are not run; put the behaviour into components, which the Loader starts
Do not load untrusted HTML into it; clean it with SF.sanitizeHtml and draw it yourself
Do not poll an address with it; refresh() reloads when the page asks
